'''Zeltros''' was an astronomical object in the [[Zeltros system]] in [[the galaxy]]'s [[Inner Rim Territories|Inner Rim]]<ref name="Appendix" /> that had [[ocean]]s and [[beach]]es with tropical [[tree]]s.<ref name="Doctor Aphra 13" /> In [[231 BBY]],<ref name="Out of the Shadows date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[The High Republic: Out of the Shadows]]'' to [[231 BBY]].</ref> [[Sylvestri Yarrow]] referenced a festival that took place on Zeltros.<ref name="Out of the Shadows">''[[The High Republic: Out of the Shadows]]''</ref>

In [[9 BBY]], [[Greez Dritus]] referred to his establishment [[Pyloon's Saloon]] as "The finest dive this side of Zeltros."<ref name="Survivor">''[[Star Wars Jedi: Survivor]]''</ref>

Following a [[Skirmish aboard the Sorca Retreat|massacre]] aboard the [[Sorca Retreat]], the rogue [[archaeologist]] [[Doctor]] [[Chelli Lona Aphra|Chelli Aphra]] traveled to Zeltros to take a break from her recent misadventures. While relaxing at a beach, being served a [[Dantooine ice-twist]] by a [[service droid]], she was confronted by [[Tukan]], who had been tracking her since she [[Death|killed]] one of his affiliates, [[Dukan]]. Defiant of his attempt to arrest her, Aphra shot him with a [[blaster]] she had been concealing. This aggravated Tukan's accomplices, who drew their own blasters on her.<ref name="Doctor Aphra 13" />

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Zeltros was first mentioned in the ''[[Star Wars]]''-themed [[roleplaying game]] [[Star Wars: The Force Awakens Beginner Game|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' Beginner Game]], published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]]<ref name="Beginner Game">[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens Beginner Game|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' Beginner Game]]</ref> in [[August]] [[2016]].<ref name="What Will You Do?">{{FantasyFlightGames|url=en/news/2016/7/26/what-will-you-do|text=What Will You Do?}}</ref> It first appeared in the [[canon]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] [[Doctor Aphra (2016) 13|''Doctor Aphra'' (2016) 13]], written by [[Kieron Gillen]], illustrated by [[Kev Walker]],<ref name="Doctor Aphra 13" /> and released on [[October 11]], [[2017]].<ref name="Newsarama">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/64825/star_wars_doctor_aphra_2016_13|text=Star Wars: Doctor Aphra (2016) #13}}</ref> Zeltros was originally first mentioned in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] comic [[Star Wars (1977) 73|''Star Wars'' (1977) 73]] written by [[Mary Jo Duffy]]<ref name="Star Wars 73">[[Star Wars (1977) 73|''Star Wars'' (1977) 73]]</ref> and published on [[March 22]], [[1983]].<ref name="ma2">''[[Marvel Age]]'' #2</ref>
